proposals.name: llm_trend_efficiency_volume_confirmation_a4588aad
proposals.economic_logic: Stronger historical trend efficiency indicates institutional trend-following capital presence, which is structurally reinforced and made sustainable over medium-term horizons when coupled with positive volume confirmation. This identifies legitimate market breakouts versus noise.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: ETFs exhibiting both high 20-day trend efficiency and strong volume confirmation will outperform the CSI 300 cross-sectionally over a 20-day horizon due to persistent institutional momentum.
failure_modes: Rapid macroeconomic policy pivots that cause sudden style rotations across industry sectors
Volume exhaustion where high volume indicates a blow-off top rather than trend continuation

proposals.name: llm_short_term_reversal_risk_mitigated_56c8c358
proposals.economic_logic: Short-term 5-day reversals typically capture temporary liquidity imbalances. Penalizing or adjusting this reversal signal by the underlying asset's 20-day volatility helps isolate high-conviction oversold mean-reversion opportunities from high-risk, structurally collapsing sectors.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: ETFs with significant 5-day downward price stretch but low historical 20-day volatility will mean-revert higher and outperform over a short-term 5-day horizon.
failure_modes: High volatility persistence leading to catching a falling knife in fundamentally broken sectors
Extended trending markets where short-term mean reversion signals fail to materialize
